newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants sued by investor group.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants sued by investor group.

text.p: Two law firms representing a group of investors said Monday they had sued First Merchants Acceptance Corp alleging violations of securities laws.

Wolf Popper LLP and Miller Faucher Chertow Cafferty & Wexler said the suit was filed in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois on April 18 on behalf of buyers of the company's stock during the period April 18, 1996, through April 17, 1997.
On April 16 First Merchants said it would restate its 1996 results after finding "irregularities involving unauthorized entries" in its records.
On April 17 the company's stock fell to $3.375 a share, "a decline of about 87 percent from its high during the class period," according to the law firms.
First Merchants was trading at 2-3/4 early Monday.
A spokeswoman for First Merchants said the company declined to comment on the purported class action suit.
